_note: Four sections. active_checks[] = the SUMMARIZED, deduped live project overlay /critique reads before every review (the ADD direction — checks the Critic was MISSING). calibration_notes[] = the LIGHTEN direction (Phase 4.1 / Theme 5): per-project signals that a model-on-model dimension/gate has been low-signal here (low precision / quiet over a window); /critique + /code-review read them to weight that dimension lighter — INFORM, never disable. gate_skips[] = the GATE-SKIP direction (Phase 3.2): a model-on-model gate measured at precision < 0.2 over >= 8 verdict runs with ZERO real blockers caught, accepted by the user to STOP its DISCRETIONARY per-slice spawn (/critique reads it in its gating DECISION — whether to run the gate at all, vs active_checks/calibration_notes which only shape an in-progress review). action = skip | tier-gate-high-only. A compliance-mandatory trigger (critic_required / Heavy / high tier) STILL forces the gate; only the discretionary spawns are removed. HARD RULE: only critique/critique-review/code-review (+ project active_checks) may be lightened or skipped; the reality spine risk-spike/validate-slice is NEVER lightened or skipped. runs[] = append-only audit history of every /critic-calibrate run; a new run NEVER overwrites a prior one. /critic-calibrate upserts accepted ADD proposals into active_checks, confirmed LIGHTEN proposals into calibration_notes (or retires a noisy active_check), accepted GATE-SKIP proposals into gate_skips, and appends the run to runs. agents/critique.md (the plugin base Critic) is NEVER edited from a project.

active_checks.check: Check auth/authz on every new API endpoint and mutation path.

calibration_notes.note: Over-engineering findings were FALSE-ALARM 4/5 times here (this project already runs lean) — weight this dimension lighter on low-tier slices; do NOT inflate. Advisory only; never a reality sign-off.

gate_skips.rationale: critique-review FALSE-ALARM 8/9 over 9 verdict runs here and caught zero blockers the first Critic missed — stop its discretionary spawn; compliance-mandatory + high-tier slices still run it; reality spine untouched.

proposals.text: Lighten the Over-engineering dimension (FALSE-ALARM 4/5 over 15 slices).
Gate-skip critique-review's discretionary spawn (precision 0.12 over 9 runs, 0 blockers).
